entries.definition: The data holds a destination that no side declaration places, so the bilateral destinations cannot be told apart from the rest.
The bilateral reading does not cover every year the answer holds.
The bilateral reading covers the years the answer shows but not every year the request reads.
Search could not decide the answer's scope; the condition is transient, and the same request may be retried.
The bilateral reading does not serve a slot the answer binds, and params.slot names that slot's property.
